title: Deardorff 8x10 Large-Format Field View Camera
purpose: Monumental 8x10 sheet film contact portraiture with infinite micro-detail, visible black film rebates, and nuanced silver tonal gradations.

sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~50mm normal field of view on 8x10 format
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15 stops analog sheet film latitude with rich silver highlight detail
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Leaf shutter in Copal #3 with quiet mechanical actuation

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Soft even natural light, open shade or diffused north skylight, plain seamless white backdrop
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Pristine silver tonal range, subtle epidermal shadow transitions, rich uncrushed shadow textures

surface_rendering: Infinite 8x10 contact-scale micro-detail: individual eyebrow hairs, skin pores, fabric fibers, and clothing seams
Authentic Kodak Tri-X silver halide micro-acutance without digital sharpening halos
Distinct black sheet film rebate border and film edge notches visible along perimeter
depth_and_optics: Frontal composition with tilt/shift plane alignment
Deep focus front to back on the subject with delicate edge softness outside depth plane
Zero perspective distortion, clean classical optical projection

execution_directive: Enforce large-format 8x10 black-and-white portrait, frontal composition, extreme detail in skin/hair/clothing, black film edge border visible, soft even natural light, plain seamless white backdrop, shot on a Deardorff 8x10 with Tri-X. Zero photographer names, series titles, or artist names in prompt.
